decisions.reason: This two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's long-standing knowledge in pumping, fluid-handling and injection equipment, so the firm is well placed to refine and commercialize it further.

As another two-component resin injection unit, it is very close to the firm's existing application and engineering base, which supports learning from early market use and improving the product efficiently.
An automatic airless spray gun fits squarely within the firm's core spray-application capabilities and customer base, making it a strong candidate to retain and develop.
A manual airless spray gun is highly consistent with the firm's established product family, service know-how and distribution channels, so keeping it is the low-risk absorptive-capacity choice.
The air-assisted airless spray gun extends familiar spray technology in a technically adjacent way that the firm can understand, support and improve with its existing expertise.

Although more digital than the firm's traditional hardware, the data logger is closely tied to coating equipment performance and can leverage the firm's installed base, service knowledge and engineering learning.
